'''''The Railway Men: The Untold Story of Bhopal 1984''''' is a 2023 Indian [[Hindi]]-language [[Historical film|historical]] [[Disaster film|disaster]] [[Thriller film|thriller]] television miniseries about railway workers who saved many lives during the [[1984 Bhopal disaster|1984 toxic gas leak]] at the chemical company [[Union Carbide India Limited]]'s plant in [[Bhopal]]. It is produced by [[Yash Raj Films#YRF Entertainment|YRF Entertainment]] (the streaming division of [[Yash Raj Films]]) and stars [[R. Madhavan]], [[Kay Kay Menon]], [[Divyenndu]] and [[Babil Khan]].<ref name="variety1">{{cite news|url=https://variety.com/2023/tv/asia/netflix-the-railway-men-aditya-chopra-1235798668/|title=Netflix's 'The Railway Men' Was Handpicked by Producer Aditya Chopra to be YRF's First Series, Director Reveals (EXCLUSIVE)|work=Variety|access-date=18 November 2023|archive-date=18 November 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118045356/https://variety.com/2023/tv/asia/netflix-the-railway-men-aditya-chopra-1235798668/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=The Railway Men: YRF's First OTT Series, Starring R Madhavan, Is Based on Bhopal Gas Tragedy |url=https://www.news18.com/news/movies/the-railway-men-yrfs-first-ott-series-based-on-bhopal-gas-tragedy-stars-r-madhavan-babil-khan-4509791.html |access-date=23 April 2022 |work=News18 |date=2 December 2021 |language=en |archive-date=23 April 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220423131152/https://www.news18.com/news/movies/the-railway-men-yrfs-first-ott-series-based-on-bhopal-gas-tragedy-stars-r-madhavan-babil-khan-4509791.html |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Sunny Hinduja]] and [[Juhi Chawla]] play supporting roles.

Filmed from December 2021 to May 2022, all four episodes of the miniseries were released on [[Netflix]] on 18 November 2023.

==Premise==
''The Railway Men'' is based on railway workers who saved many lives during the [[Bhopal disaster|1984 gas tragedy]] at the chemical company [[Union Carbide India Limited]]'s plant in [[Bhopal]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Singh |first1=Suhani |title=Netflix's 'The Railway Men': A few good men |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine/leisure/story/20231127-netflixs-the-railway-men-a-few-good-men-2464304-2023-11-17 |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=India Today |date=18 November 2023}}</ref> The series is inspired by the efforts of station master Ghulam Dastagir and his team at the [[Bhopal Junction railway station]] on the night of the tragedy.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2019-12-04 |title=Bhopal gas tragedy: An unsung hero who saved many lives |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bhopal/an-unsung-hero-who-saved-many-lives/articleshow/72355810.cms |access-date=2023-11-27 |issn=0971-8257 |archive-date=6 October 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221006191308/https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/bhopal/an-unsung-hero-who-saved-many-lives/articleshow/72355810.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

| ShortSummary    = Employees at the [[Union Carbide India Limited]] work under negligible safety protocols. Imad Riaz, a former employee, talks to a journalist, Kumawat, about the death of his friend at the plant due to toxic gas inhalation. He says that the management took no action and fired him instead for complaining. A manager at the plant, Kamruddin, also tries to give information to Kumawat about the lack of safety at the crumbling plant. Meanwhile, Iftekaar Siddiqui is an idealistic station master of the [[Bhopal Junction railway station]]. A dacoit named Balwant Yadav intent on looting the station safe-house introduces himself to Iftekaar as a cop in pursuit of the dacoit. On the night of 2 December 1984, due to malfunctioning instruments and untrained workers at the plant, a highly toxic gas [[Methyl isocyanate]] (MIC) leaks into the atmosphere, instantly killing many workers, including Kamruddin.

| ShortSummary    = As the gas starts spreading into the highly populated [[Bhopal]] city, hordes of people begin to collapse in the streets, many of whom die. At Bhopal Junction station, Iftekaar and Balwant are initially confused by the chaos. They soon realise that people who were indoors were seemingly unharmed. They try to gather the crowds into the station waiting room. Due to incomplete cable repair work, communication systems are down, and Iftekaar has no way to reach nearby stations and warn them. Imad, who had begun a new job as a [[loco pilot]], becomes aware of the gas leak due to his past history. He goes to the station to warn Iftekaar. Meanwhile, at Itarsi Junction, Rati Pandey, a general manager for the Indian Railways, becomes aware of the situation.

==Production==
''The Railway Men'' marked the directorial debut of Shiv Rawail, who was an assistant director at [[Yash Raj Films]].<ref name="variety1"/> It also marked the first streaming fiction series of the company, under their subdivision YRF Entertainment.<ref name="variety1"/>

The series began filming on 1 December 2021 and wrapped on 11 May 2022.<ref>{{cite news |last=Shackleton |first=Liz |title=India's Yash Raj Films enters streaming production with 'The Railway Men' |url=https://www.screendaily.com/news/indias-yash-raj-films-enters-streaming-production-with-the-railway-men/5165669.article |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=Screen Daily |date=2 December 2021 |archive-date=29 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240629074854/https://www.screendaily.com/news/indias-yash-raj-films-enters-streaming-production-with-the-railway-men/5165669.article |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Babil Khan wraps shooting for web series 'The Railway Men' |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/babil-khan-wraps-shooting-for-web-series-the-railway-men/articleshow/91507036.cms |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=The Economic Times |date=11 May 2022 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118092953/https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/magazines/panache/babil-khan-wraps-shooting-for-web-series-the-railway-men/articleshow/91507036.cms |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Release ==
Two former employees of Union Carbide India Limited, convicted in the gas leak case, filed a plea to prevent the release of the series; the [[Bombay High Court]] rejected their case.<ref>{{cite news |title=HC rejects stay on OTT release of web series based on Bhopal gas tragedy |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/others/hc-rejects-stay-on-ott-release-of-web-series-based-on-bhopal-gas-tragedy-101700248963803.html |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=Hindustan Times |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118072228/https://www.hindustantimes.com/cities/others/hc-rejects-stay-on-ott-release-of-web-series-based-on-bhopal-gas-tragedy-101700248963803.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

The series was released on [[Netflix]] on 18 November 2023.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Whittock |first1=Jesse |title=Netflix & Yash Raj Films On Track To Launch 'The Railway Men' In November |url=https://deadline.com/2023/10/netflix-yash-raj-films-the-railway-men-launch-date-november-18-1235583766/ |access-date=26 October 2023 |work=Deadline |date=26 October 2023 |archive-date=29 June 2024 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240629074851/https://deadline.com/2023/10/netflix-yash-raj-films-the-railway-men-launch-date-november-18-1235583766/ |url-status=live }}</ref>

== Reception ==
Nandini Ramnath of ''[[Scroll.in]]'' found ''The Railway Men'' to be a "compelling saga of ordinary heroism"; she particularly praised the production design by Rajat Poddar for his "remarkably faithful recreations" of the era.<ref>{{cite web |last=Ramnath |first=Nandini |title='The Railway Men' review: A compelling saga of ordinary heroism |url=https://scroll.in/reel/1059168/the-railway-men-review-a-compelling-saga-of-ordinary-heroism |access-date=18 November 2023 |website=Scroll.in |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118081020/https://scroll.in/reel/1059168/the-railway-men-review-a-compelling-saga-of-ordinary-heroism |url-status=live }}</ref> Sonil Dedhia of ''[[News18]]'' considered it a "passionate, emotionally resonant, and incredibly moving" tale of under-appreciated heroes, but felt that too many subplots and backstories prevented it from being a "taut thriller".<ref>{{cite web |last=Dedhia |first=Sonil |title=The Railway Men Review: Kay Kay Menon, R Madhavan's Show Is Hard-Hitting But Brings Too Many Sub-Plots |url=https://www.news18.com/movies/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavans-show-is-hard-hitting-but-brings-too-many-sub-plots-8666967.html |access-date=18 November 2023 |website=News18 |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118081531/https://www.news18.com/movies/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavans-show-is-hard-hitting-but-brings-too-many-sub-plots-8666967.html |url-status=live }}</ref> Mayur Sanap of ''[[Rediff.com]]'' commended Rawail for handling the tragic event with "seriousness and respect without going overboard with the dramatic impact".<ref>{{cite web |last=Sanap |first=Mayur |title=The Railway Men Review: Compelling Watch |url=https://www.rediff.com/movies/review/the-railway-men-review/20231118.htm |access-date=18 November 2023 |website=Rediff.com |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118084723/https://www.rediff.com/movies/review/the-railway-men-review/20231118.htm |url-status=live }}</ref>

''[[The Indian Express]]''{{'s}} [[Shubhra Gupta]] termed it "a worthy effort, which brings back an expansive, old-fashioned style of storytelling to a still-relevant event", and particularly praised the performances of Kay Kay Menon and Babil Khan.<ref>{{cite news |last=Gupta |first=Shubhra |title=The Railway Men review: Kay Kay Menon, Babil Khan give terrific performances in a worthy show |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/web-series/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-babil-khan-give-terrific-performances-in-a-worthy-show-9032061/ |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=The Indian Express |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118083000/https://indianexpress.com/article/entertainment/web-series/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-babil-khan-give-terrific-performances-in-a-worthy-show-9032061/ |url-status=live }}</ref> ''[[India Today]]''{{'s}} Zinia Bandyopadhyay considered Khan to be the "real star of the show".<ref>{{cite news |last=Bandyopadhyay |first=Zinia |title=The Railway Men Review: Great performances, good script elevate this gripping drama |url=https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/reviews/story/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavan-babil-khan-divyenndu-sharma-juhi-chawla-2464526-2023-11-18 |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=India Today |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118090713/https://www.indiatoday.in/movies/reviews/story/the-railway-men-review-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavan-babil-khan-divyenndu-sharma-juhi-chawla-2464526-2023-11-18 |url-status=live }}</ref> [[Saibal Chatterjee]] of ''[[NDTV]]'' wrote, "''The Railway Men'' is buoyed by a clutch of laudable performances and storytelling that does not slide below a certain level of competence. But it could have been much, much more."<ref>{{cite web|last=Chatterjee|first=Saibal|title=The Railway Men Review: Buoyed By Laudable Performances But Could Have Been Much More|url=https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/the-railway-men-review-buoyed-by-laudable-performances-but-could-have-been-much-more-2-5-stars-4584727|access-date=18 November 2023|website=NDTV|date=18 November 2023|archive-date=18 November 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118085221/https://www.ndtv.com/entertainment/the-railway-men-review-buoyed-by-laudable-performances-but-could-have-been-much-more-2-5-stars-4584727|url-status=live}}</ref> Santanu Das of ''[[Hindustan Times]]'' believed that the series' handling of the tragedy was not at par with the handling of the [[Chernobyl disaster]] by the [[HBO]] miniseries ''[[Chernobyl (miniseries)|Chernobyl]]'' (2019).<ref>{{cite news |last=Das |first=Santanu |title=The Railway Men review: Real life tragedy of the Bhopal gas leak feels too manufactured |url=https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/web-series/the-railway-men-review-bhopal-gas-leak-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavan-babil-khan-netflix-india-101700322890852.html |access-date=18 November 2023 |work=Hindustan Times |date=18 November 2023 |archive-date=18 November 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231118163320/https://www.hindustantimes.com/entertainment/web-series/the-railway-men-review-bhopal-gas-leak-kay-kay-menon-r-madhavan-babil-khan-netflix-india-101700322890852.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

The Railway Men: The Untold Story of Bhopal 1984 is a 2023 Indian Hindi-language historical disaster thriller television miniseries about railway workers who saved many lives during the 1984 toxic gas leak at the chemical company Union Carbide India Limited's plant in Bhopal. It is produced by YRF Entertainment (the streaming division of Yash Raj Films) and stars R. Madhavan, Kay Kay Menon, Divyenndu and Babil Khan. Sunny Hinduja and Juhi Chawla play supporting roles.
Filmed from December 2021 to May 2022, all four episodes of the miniseries were released on Netflix on 18 November 2023.
